headlines.headline: NBA preseason rolls through Boulder as Nuggets host Jazz at CU's Events Center
headlines.detail: Four preseason games tipped off Sunday night. The Clippers debuted their overhauled roster — Brandon Ingram, Gradey Dick, Rui Hachimura, and Max Strus — against Golden State, though newly signed guard Bradley Beal (knee) was doubtful and did not play.

headlines.headline: Rams rally from 10 down to stun Eagles 24-20 as Patriots upset Bills in Week 4 Sunday slate
headlines.detail: Los Angeles overcame a fourth-quarter deficit to beat Philadelphia, while New England's 29-26 win over Buffalo was the day's biggest surprise. Saquon Barkley (hamstring) and Ja'Marr Chase (concussion) were both ruled out.

headlines.headline: Texas holds No. 1 in the AP Poll as Alabama and Missouri deliver Week 5's biggest results
headlines.detail: Alabama's 56-23 rout of Mississippi State vaulted the Crimson Tide to No. 1 in rival rankings, and Missouri's 45-17 upset of Florida was the day's signature result. Ohio State's Jeremiah Smith had 12 catches, 217 yards, and four TDs against Illinois.

headlines.headline: St. John's guard Freeman to miss entire 2026-27 season after Achilles surgery
headlines.detail: The rising junior suffered a non-contact Achilles injury in a workout. Coach Rick Pitino: "Donnie had a non-contact injury in a workout and will miss the season."
